color-system.twistDescription: Verbatim copy — warm cream #fcf7f1 background, near-black #000000 body text, deep navy #1e3a6e accent

type-system.twistDescription: Maximum weight contrast: Playfair Display 900 display serif paired with DM Sans 300 grotesque body. h1 at clamp(6rem,12vw,14rem) with -0.05em tracking. Display-to-body weight ratio 900:300 is the entire hierarchy system.

motion-system.twistDescription: Word-slide keyframe (y:30→0, opacity resolves at 60%) and weight-pulse clip-path wipe added. Reveal duration extended to 0.7s. Stagger tokens 0.12s increments.

grid-system.twistDescription: Typography-first editorial column grid — 12-column with 18px gutters, .layout-prose (680px), .layout-display (full-bleed), .layout-two-col-editorial (2fr/3fr)

spacing-system.twistDescription: All vertical values scaled ×1.2 for editorial breathing room. --space-section-break:120px and --space-type-margin:80px tokens added.

interaction-states.twistDescription: Typographic hover: letter-spacing +0.02em on button hover, scaleX underline reveal on links. No color changes, no box-shadow, no scale transforms.

nav-system.twistDescription: Masthead editorial style: uppercase 0.75rem 0.08em tracking, no pill, scaleX underline hover, 1px borderBottom on scroll only. No color inversion.

concept-summary.twistDescription: Typography-first editorial concept: type as architecture, 900:300 weight register, hairline rules, warm paper surface. Video placements: hero-type-motion.mp4, editorial-pages.mp4, letterpress-craft.mp4.
